description: This file defines classes, enums, and structures related to Bluetooth SDP (Service Discovery Protocol) profiles, including ClassID, Service, and Tree, along with client and server classes for SDP communication. It contains Bluetooth service and profile identifiers, attribute descriptors, and serialization/deserialization methods.

classes.name: ClassID
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth Class ID with UUID and name functionalities.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth SDP Service with attributes, serialization, and deserialization capabilities.

classes.name: Tree
classes.description: Manages a collection of Bluetooth SDP services, allowing addition and lookup.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Implements a Bluetooth SDP client for service discovery and attribute retrieval.

classes.name: Server
classes.description: Abstract base class for a Bluetooth SDP server handling PDU requests and service tree management.

methods.name: Discover
methods.description: Discovers services on a remote device.

methods.name: ServiceAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves attributes of a specific service.

methods.name: ServiceSearchAttribute
methods.description: Performs combined service search and attribute retrieval.

methods.name: WithServiceTree
methods.description: Configures the server with a service tree.

methods.name: OnPDU
methods.description: Handles incoming PDU requests based on PDU type.
